results.quote: **`preview` and `generate` commands.** Run `chartula preview` or `chartula generate` with `--tag` and `--repo <owner/name>`. `generate` writes `changelog.json`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the GitHub release notes; `preview` runs the identical flow, including generation, so you see the real result, but writes and publishes nothing. Both print a usage screen, a readable per-audience summary, and clear messages for unknown commands, a missing `--tag` or an invalid `--repo` instead of crashing. `--repo` must be given explicitly for now, and review mode uses the auto-approve reviewer until the interactive console reviewer is built.

results.quote: Generated text could be cut off mid-sentence. Requests to the language model didn't set an output length limit, so the provider silently applied its own default and truncated all three audience texts. This failed quietly — the run reported success, and the thorough check spent tens of thousands of tokens flagging the cut-off text as an unsupported claim, when the real problem was truncation. The output limit is now always set explicitly, configurable via `llm.maxOutputTokens`, defaulting to 16000.
